title: dryopteris wardii
intro: Dryopteris wardii, commonly known as the Chinese shield fern, is a species of fern in the genus Dryopteris. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help reduce symptoms of fever, diarrhea, and cough. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris wardii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris wardii have been shown to have potential health benefits, including immune system modulation and anti-tumor activities.
